about: Activities of people who are not key figures, taken from what their card says they did, so each one shows on the lifespan.

people: person id -> list of activities; an activity is [year, text, scripture, { c: 1 if the year is approximate, p: place id in data/places.js, zh: Chinese text }] or the name of an activity in shared.
shared: activities that several people took part in (the 12 spies, joining David at Ziklag, the wall rebuilt under Nehemiah).

Years follow the chronology of Insight on the Scriptures and the New World Translation (Appendix A6, A7); a year marked c is approximate, placed within the person's life from the setting of the account.
dates: placeholder lives (born, died) moved so that they take in an activity.
Run node tools/build-people.mjs after editing; it warns about an activity that falls outside the person's life.

eleazar-1.zh: 和約書亞一起把土地分給各部族

zimri-2.zh: 把米甸女子歌斯比帶進帳幕；非尼哈把他們兩人都殺了

phinehas-1.zh: 被派去見約旦河東的部族，查問他們築壇的事，平息了爭端

phinehas-1.zh: 以色列人與便雅憫人作戰時，他擔任大祭司

og.zh: 在以得雷被以色列人擊敗；他的60座設防城被攻佔

mahlah-1: With her sisters, asks for her dead father's inheritance; Jehovah grants it

mahlah-1.zh: 和姊妹們請求繼承亡父的產業；耶和華准了

mahlah-1.zh: 嫁給瑪拿西部族的堂兄弟，使產業留在本族

milcah-2: With her sisters, asks for her dead father's inheritance; Jehovah grants it

milcah-2.zh: 和姊妹們請求繼承亡父的產業；耶和華准了

jair-1: Captures tent villages in Gilead and names them Havvoth-jair

jair-1.zh: 攻取基列的帳篷村落，稱為哈倭特睚珥

nobah-1: Captures Kenath and its towns and names it after himself

nobah-1.zh: 攻取基納和附屬的城鎮，用自己的名字稱呼那地

achan: Secretly takes devoted things from Jericho

achan.zh: 偷偷拿了耶利哥城中當毀滅的東西

achan.zh: 他的罪使以色列人在艾城戰敗；抽籤被揭發，和全家被石頭打死

jabin-1.zh: 約書亞攻取並焚燒夏瑣時被處死

jobab-3.zh: 加入夏瑣王耶賓的聯盟；在米倫水邊被擊敗

achsah: Given as wife to Othniel for capturing Debir; asks her father for land with springs

achsah.zh: 因俄陀聶攻取底璧而嫁給他；向父親求得有泉水的地

adoni-bezek: Captured by Judah and Simeon; suffers what he did to 70 kings and dies in Jerusalem

adoni-bezek.zh: 被猶大人和西緬人捉住，受到他對70個王所做的同樣懲罰，死在耶路撒冷

micah-1: Returns stolen silver that becomes an idol in his house; hires a Levite as priest

micah-1.zh: 歸還偷去的銀子，這些銀子被做成偶像放在他家裡；他聘請一個利未人作祭司

micah-1.zh: 遷移的但族人奪走了他的偶像和祭司

jonathan-1: Becomes priest for Micah's carved image

jonathan-1.zh: 成為米迦雕刻偶像的祭司

jonathan-1.zh: 跟隨但族人，作他們的祭司

cushan-rishathaim: Rules Israel for eight years until Othniel defeats him

cushan-rishathaim.zh: 統治以色列人八年，後來被俄陀聶擊敗

jabez-1.zh: 祈求耶和華賜福，上帝應允了他

elimelech.zh: 在饑荒時帶全家移居摩押，後來死在那裡

zebah.zh: 在加各被捉住，被基甸處死

jether-5: Too afraid as a youth to execute the Midianite kings

jether-5.zh: 年少膽怯，不敢處死米甸的王

jether-5: Killed by his half brother Abimelech

jether-5.zh: 被同父異母的兄弟亞比米勒殺死

abimelech-4.zh: 殺了70個同父異母的兄弟，在示劍被立為王

abimelech-4.zh: 平定迦阿勒的叛亂，毀了示劍城

ibzan.zh: 在耶弗他之後作以色列的士師七年

phinehas-2.zh: 和何弗尼一起褻瀆祭物，在聖所行淫亂

kish-3: Sends his son Saul to look for lost she-asses

hadad-2: Defeats Midian in the territory of Moab

hadad-2.zh: 在摩押境內擊敗米甸人

abinadab-2.zh: 撒母耳來膏立耶西的一個兒子時，沒有選他

abinadab-2.zh: 在掃羅的軍隊中對抗歌利亞

shammah-2: Passed over when Samuel comes to anoint one of Jesse's sons

shammah-2.zh: 撒母耳來膏立耶西的一個兒子時，沒有選他

shammah-2: Serves in Saul's army facing Goliath

shammah-2.zh: 在掃羅的軍隊中對抗歌利亞

merab: Promised to David by Saul but given to Adriel instead

merab.zh: 掃羅答應把她嫁給大衛，卻把她給了亞得列

abiathar.zh: 在挪伯的大屠殺中逃脫，投奔大衛

abiathar.zh: 在押沙龍叛亂時忠於大衛；把約櫃抬回耶路撒冷

abiathar.zh: 支持亞多尼雅；所羅門革除了他的祭司職務

achish.zh: 大衛逃到他那裡，假裝瘋癲

achish: Gives the fugitive David the town of Ziklag

achish.zh: 把洗革拉城給了逃亡的大衛

achish: Shimei's runaway slaves flee to him in Solomon's reign

achish.zh: 所羅門統治期間，示每的奴隸逃到他那裡

gad-3: Advises David to leave the stronghold and go to Judah

gad-3.zh: 勸大衛離開要塞，到猶大地去

spirit-medium-of-en-dor: Disguised Saul asks her to bring up Samuel, the night before he dies

spirit-medium-of-en-dor.zh: 喬裝的掃羅在死前一晚請她招撒母耳上來

abinadab-3: Killed by the Philistines at Mount Gilboa with his father and brothers

abinadab-3.zh: 和父親、兄弟一起在基利波山被非利士人殺死

abner-1.zh: 立掃羅的兒子伊施波設作王

baanah-1.zh: 和弟兄利甲一起殺了伊施波設；大衛下令處死他們

rechab-1.zh: 和弟兄巴阿拿一起殺了伊施波設；大衛下令處死他們

joab-2: Kills Abner to avenge his brother Asahel

joab-2.zh: 殺了押尼珥，為弟弟亞撒黑報仇

joab-2: Leads the capture of Jerusalem and becomes army chief

joab-2.zh: 率先攻佔耶路撒冷，成為軍隊的統帥
違背大衛的命令，殺了押沙龍

joab-2: Backs Adonijah; executed at Solomon's order

joab-2.zh: 支持亞多尼雅；所羅門下令將他處死

asaph-1: Appointed a chief singer, playing cymbals, when the Ark comes to Jerusalem

asaph-1.zh: 約櫃運到耶路撒冷時，被委任為首席歌手，敲鐃鈸

chenaniah-1: Instructs the Levites in carrying the Ark properly

uzzah-2: Grabs the Ark to steady it and is struck dead

ahio-1c: Walks ahead of the Ark when his brother Uzzah is struck down

ahio-1c.zh: 走在約櫃前面，那時他的兄弟烏撒被擊殺

rizpah: Guards the bodies of her executed sons until David has them buried

rizpah.zh: 看守她被處死的兒子們的屍體，直到大衛把他們埋葬

armoni: Handed over to the Gibeonites and executed for Saul's bloodguilt

armoni.zh: 被交給基遍人處死，為掃羅的血債贖罪

mephibosheth-1: Handed over to the Gibeonites and executed for Saul's bloodguilt

mephibosheth-1.zh: 被交給基遍人處死，為掃羅的血債贖罪

adriel: His five sons are executed for Saul's bloodguilt

adriel.zh: 他的五個兒子被處死，為掃羅的血債贖罪

hadadezer: Defeated by David on his way to the Euphrates

hadadezer: Allied with Ammon, defeated again; his vassals make peace with Israel

hadadezer.zh: 與亞捫結盟，再次戰敗；他的附庸與以色列講和

toi.zh: 派兒子帶禮物去祝賀大衛打敗哈達德謝

joram-1: Sent by his father Toi with costly gifts to congratulate David

joram-1.zh: 奉父親陀以之命，帶貴重禮物去祝賀大衛

hadoram-2: Sent by King Tou with gifts to congratulate David

hadoram-2.zh: 奉陀烏王之命，帶禮物去祝賀大衛

hanun-1.zh: 僱用敘利亞人作戰；以色列人打敗亞捫，攻佔拉巴

uriah-1: Refuses to go home while the army is in the field; David has him killed in battle

uriah-1.zh: 軍隊在野外作戰，他不肯回家；大衛設計使他戰死

amnon-1.zh: 強暴了同父異母的妹妹塔瑪

amnon-1: Killed by Absalom's servants at a sheep-shearing feast

amnon-1.zh: 在剪羊毛的宴席上被押沙龍的僕人殺死

tamar-1b: Raped by her half brother Amnon; lives desolate in Absalom's house

tamar-1b.zh: 被同父異母的哥哥暗嫩強暴；在押沙龍家裡孤單度日

talmai-2: His grandson Absalom flees to him after killing Amnon, for three years

talmai-2.zh: 外孫押沙龍殺了暗嫩後逃到他那裡，住了三年

elhanan-1: Strikes down Lahmi, the brother of Goliath

lahmi.zh: 在與非利士人的戰爭中被伊勒哈南擊殺

sibbecai: Kills Saph (Sippai), a descendant of the Rephaim

jonathan-4: Kills a taunting giant with six fingers on each hand at Gath

jonathan-4.zh: 在迦特擊殺一個每隻手有六根指頭、向以色列人辱罵的巨人

eleazar-3: Holds a barley field at Pas-dammim and strikes down Philistines

eleazar-3.zh: 在帕斯達閔守住一塊大麥田，擊殺非利士人

jashobeam-2: Kills hundreds with his spear; later leads the first army division

ahithophel.zh: 離開大衛，成為押沙龍的謀士

ahithophel.zh: 他的計謀不被採納；回家上吊自殺

hushai.zh: 假裝支持押沙龍；推翻亞希多弗的計謀，並通知大衛

jonathan-3: With Ahimaaz, carries secret messages to David during Absalom's revolt

jonathan-3.zh: 在押沙龍叛亂時，和亞希瑪斯一起把秘密消息傳給大衛

jonathan-3: Brings Adonijah's guests the news that Solomon is king

jonathan-3.zh: 向亞多尼雅的賓客報告所羅門已經作王

shimei-12: Curses David and throws stones at him as he flees from Absalom

shimei-12.zh: 大衛逃離押沙龍時，咒罵他，向他扔石頭

shimei-12: Begs David's pardon and is spared

shimei-12.zh: 請求大衛寬恕，得到饒命

shimei-12: Leaves Jerusalem against his oath; executed at Solomon's order

shimei-12.zh: 違背誓言離開耶路撒冷；所羅門下令將他處死

shobi: Brings supplies to David at Mahanaim

shobi.zh: 把供應物資帶到瑪哈念給大衛

machir-b: Having sheltered Mephibosheth, he brings supplies to David at Mahanaim

machir-b.zh: 曾收留米非波設，又把供應物資帶到瑪哈念給大衛

barzillai-2.zh: 在瑪哈念供應大衛所需

barzillai-2: At 80, declines a place at David's court and sends Chimham instead

barzillai-2.zh: 80歲時婉拒到大衛的宮廷生活，請金罕代替他去

amasa-1: Commands Absalom's army in the revolt

amasa-1.zh: 在叛亂中統領押沙龍的軍隊

amasa-1: Named David's army chief; killed by Joab while pursuing Sheba

amasa-1.zh: 被任命為大衛的軍隊統帥；追擊示巴時被約押殺死

zadok-1: Stays loyal to David in Absalom's revolt; returns the Ark to Jerusalem

zadok-1.zh: 在押沙龍叛亂時忠於大衛；把約櫃抬回耶路撒冷
在基訓膏立所羅門為王

benaiah-1: Executes Adonijah and Joab for Solomon; made army chief

benaiah-1.zh: 奉所羅門之命處決亞多尼雅和約押；被任命為軍隊統帥

rei: Stays loyal to David and refuses to back Adonijah

rei.zh: 忠於大衛，不支持亞多尼雅

adonijah-1: Tries to seize the throne in David's old age; foiled by Nathan

adonijah-1.zh: 在大衛年老時企圖奪取王位；被拿單阻止

adonijah-1: Asks for Abishag as wife; executed by Solomon

adonijah-1.zh: 請求娶亞比莎為妻；被所羅門處死

pharaoh-s-daughter-2: Marries Solomon in an alliance with Egypt; he later builds her a house

pharaoh-s-daughter-2.zh: 與所羅門聯姻，使以色列與埃及結盟；後來所羅門為她建了一座宮殿

hadad-4: As a boy escapes Joab's massacre of Edom and flees to Egypt

hadad-4.zh: 年少時逃過約押對以東人的屠殺，逃到埃及

hadad-4: Returns from Egypt to oppose Solomon

hadad-4.zh: 從埃及回來與所羅門作對

hiram-2: Makes the temple furnishings for Solomon

hiram-2.zh: 為所羅門製造聖殿的器具

hiram-abi: Makes the temple furnishings for Solomon

hiram-abi.zh: 為所羅門製造聖殿的器具

rezon: Rules Syria from Damascus and opposes Israel throughout Solomon's reign

rezon.zh: 在大馬士革統治敘利亞，在所羅門統治期間一直與以色列作對

adoniram: Stoned to death by the rebels at Shechem

adoniram.zh: 在示劍被叛亂的人用石頭打死

shemaiah-6: Stops Rehoboam from fighting the ten tribes

shemaiah-6.zh: 阻止羅波安攻打十個部族
示撒入侵時警告羅波安

ahijah-7: Tears his garment into 12 pieces: Jeroboam is to rule ten tribes

ahijah-7.zh: 把衣服撕成12片：耶羅波安要統治十個部族

ahijah-7: Foretells the death of Jeroboam's son and the end of his house

ahijah-7.zh: 預言耶羅波安的兒子會死，他的家族要滅亡

jeroboam-s-wife: Goes in disguise to the prophet Ahijah about her sick son

jeroboam-s-wife.zh: 喬裝去見先知亞希雅，詢問生病的兒子

abijah-6a: Dies as Ahijah foretold; mourned and buried with honor

abijah-6a.zh: 如亞希雅所預言的死了；全以色列為他哀哭，得到體面的埋葬

abijah-5: Denounces calf worship and routs Jeroboam's much larger army

abijah-5.zh: 譴責崇拜牛犢的行為，擊潰耶羅波安人數多得多的軍隊

nadab-4: Becomes king of Israel and keeps up calf worship

nadab-4.zh: 成為以色列王，繼續崇拜牛犢

nadab-4: Assassinated by Baasha while besieging Gibbethon

nadab-4.zh: 圍攻基比頓時被巴沙殺害

baasha: Kills Nadab, seizes the throne and wipes out Jeroboam's house

baasha.zh: 殺了拿答，奪取王位，消滅耶羅波安全家

baasha: Fortifies Ramah against Asa; withdraws when Syria attacks his north

baasha.zh: 建造拉瑪，對抗亞撒；敘利亞人攻擊北方時撤退

ben-hadad-a: Bribed by Asa, breaks his treaty with Baasha and attacks northern Israel

ben-hadad-a.zh: 接受亞撒的賄賂，背棄與巴沙的盟約，攻擊以色列北部

hanani-2: Rebukes Asa for relying on Syria; put in the stocks

hanani-2.zh: 責備亞撒倚靠敘利亞；被上了木枷

azariah-6a: His message moves Asa to remove idols and make a covenant to seek Jehovah

azariah-6a.zh: 他的信息促使亞撒除掉偶像，與百姓立約尋求耶和華

maacah-9: Removed as queen mother by Asa for making an idol for the sacred pole

maacah-9.zh: 因為給神聖柱子造偶像，被亞撒廢去太后的地位

zerah-6: Invades Judah with a million men; defeated at Mareshah and pursued to Gerar

zerah-6.zh: 率領一百萬大軍入侵猶大；在瑪利沙戰敗，被追到基拉耳

jehu-2: Foretells the end of Baasha's dynasty

jehu-2.zh: 預言巴沙的王朝會滅亡

elah-3: Succeeds his father Baasha as king of Israel

elah-3.zh: 繼承父親巴沙成為以色列王

elah-3: Killed by Zimri while drunk at Arza's house

elah-3.zh: 在亞察家裡喝醉時被心利殺死

arza: Zimri kills the drunken King Elah in his house

arza.zh: 心利在他家裡殺死喝醉的以拉王

zimri-3: Murders King Elah and wipes out Baasha's house

zimri-3.zh: 殺了以拉王，消滅巴沙全家

zimri-3: Rules seven days; when Omri besieges Tirzah, he burns the palace over himself

zimri-3.zh: 作王七天；暗利圍攻得撒時，他放火焚燒王宮，自焚而死

omri-3: Made king by the army after Zimri's coup

omri-3.zh: 心利叛變後被軍隊立為王

omri-3: Prevails over Tibni and rules all Israel

omri-3.zh: 勝過提比尼，統治全以色列

omri-3: Buys the hill of Samaria and builds his capital there

omri-3.zh: 買下撒馬利亞山，在那裡建造首都

tibni: Vies with Omri for the kingship; dies after some four years

tibni.zh: 與暗利爭奪王位；約四年後死去

shemer-3: Sells King Omri the hill of Samaria for two silver talents

shemer-3.zh: 以兩他連得銀子把撒馬利亞山賣給暗利王

widow-of-zarephath: Feeds Elijah with her last flour and oil; the jar and jug do not run out

widow-of-zarephath.zh: 用僅存的麵粉和油供養以利亞；她的麵和油一直沒有用盡

widow-of-zarephath: Elijah raises her son from the dead

widow-of-zarephath.zh: 以利亞使她的兒子復活

abiram-2: Dies when his father rebuilds Jericho, as Joshua's curse foretold

abiram-2.zh: 父親重建耶利哥時死去，應驗了約書亞的咒詛

segub-2: Dies when his father rebuilds Jericho, as Joshua's curse foretold

segub-2.zh: 父親重建耶利哥時死去，應驗了約書亞的咒詛

amasiah: Commands one of Jehoshaphat's army divisions of 200,000

amasiah.zh: 統領約沙法的一支二十萬人的軍隊

amariah-3: Appointed chief priest over every matter of Jehovah, especially legal cases

amariah-3.zh: 被委任為祭司長，管理一切有關耶和華的事，特別是審判的案件

naboth: Refuses to sell his vineyard to Ahab; Jezebel has him falsely accused and stoned

naboth.zh: 不肯把葡萄園賣給亞哈；耶洗別設計誣告他，使他被石頭打死

ben-hadad-b: Besieges Samaria with 32 vassal kings; defeated by Ahab, then spared

ben-hadad-b.zh: 率領32個附庸王圍攻撒馬利亞；被亞哈擊敗，後來被饒命

micaiah-2: Unlike Ahab's 400 prophets, foretells Israel's defeat at Ramoth-gilead

micaiah-2.zh: 和亞哈的400個先知不同，預言以色列人會在基列拉末戰敗

zedekiah-1: Makes iron horns to promise Ahab victory; strikes Micaiah on the cheek

zedekiah-1.zh: 做了鐵角，向亞哈保證會得勝；打了米該雅的臉

ahaziah-1: Becomes king of Israel and continues Baal worship

ahaziah-1.zh: 成為以色列王，繼續崇拜巴力

ahaziah-1: His joint shipping venture with Jehoshaphat fails

ahaziah-1.zh: 與約沙法合作造船，結果失敗

ahaziah-1: Falls through a lattice and dies, as Elijah foretold

ahaziah-1.zh: 從窗格子掉下來，後來死了，正如以利亞所預言的

eliezer-6: Foretells the wreck of the ships Jehoshaphat built with Ahaziah

eliezer-6.zh: 預言約沙法和亞哈謝合造的船會毀壞

jahaziel-4: Under God's spirit, tells Jehoshaphat the battle is God's

jahaziel-4.zh: 受上帝的靈感動，告訴約沙法這場戰爭是上帝的

jehoram-3: Becomes sole king of Judah and kills all his brothers

jehoram-3.zh: 成為猶大唯一的王，殺了他所有的兄弟

jehoram-3: Dies of a disease foretold in a letter from Elijah

jehoram-3.zh: 死於以利亞在信中預言的疾病

ahaziah-2: Becomes king of Judah under his mother Athaliah's influence

ahaziah-2.zh: 在母親亞他利雅的影響下成為猶大王

ahaziah-2: Wounded by Jehu's men; dies at Megiddo

ahaziah-2.zh: 被耶戶的人射傷，死在米吉多

athaliah-1: Murders the royal heirs and seizes the throne

athaliah-1.zh: 殺害王室的後裔，篡奪王位
耶何耶大擁立約阿施作王時被處死

jehosheba: Rescues the infant Jehoash from Athaliah and hides him in the temple

jehosheba.zh: 從亞他利雅手中救出嬰孩約阿施，把他藏在聖殿裡

jehoash-1: As a baby, rescued from Athaliah and hidden in the temple six years

jehoash-1.zh: 還是嬰孩時從亞他利雅手中被救出，在聖殿裡藏了六年

jehoash-1: Crowned king at seven by Jehoiada

jehoash-1.zh: 七歲時被耶何耶大擁立為王

jehoash-1: Killed by his servants after he had Zechariah son of Jehoiada stoned

jehoash-1.zh: 他使耶何耶大的兒子撒迦利亞被石頭打死，後來被自己的僕人殺害

mattan-1: Killed before Baal's altars when the people tear down Baal's house

mattan-1.zh: 百姓拆毀巴力的廟時，他在巴力的祭壇前被殺

jehonadab-1b: Rides with Jehu and backs his eradication of Baal worship in Samaria

jehonadab-1b.zh: 與耶戶同車，支持他在撒馬利亞剷除巴力崇拜

hazael: Smothers Ben-hadad and seizes the throne of Syria, as Elisha foretold

hazael.zh: 悶死便哈達，奪取敘利亞的王位，正如以利沙所預言的

gehazi: Points out that the Shunammite has no son; later her son is raised

gehazi.zh: 指出書念婦人沒有兒子；後來她的兒子死而復活

gehazi: Takes gifts from Naaman by deceit and is struck with leprosy

gehazi.zh: 用詭計向乃縵索取禮物，結果染上痲瘋

jehoahaz-2: Succeeds his father Jehu as king of Israel

jehoahaz-2.zh: 繼承父親耶戶作以色列王

jehoahaz-2: Oppressed by Hazael, he seeks Jehovah, who gives Israel a savior

jehoahaz-2.zh: 受哈薛欺壓，他懇求耶和華，耶和華就給以色列人一位拯救者

jehozabad-3: With Jozacar, kills King Jehoash for murdering Zechariah son of Jehoiada

jehozabad-3.zh: 和約撒甲一起殺了約阿施王，因為王殺害了耶何耶大的兒子撒迦利亞

jehozabad-3: Executed by Amaziah when the kingdom is firm in his hand

jehozabad-3.zh: 亞瑪謝掌穩王權後將他處死

jozacar: With Jehozabad, kills King Jehoash for murdering Zechariah son of Jehoiada

jozacar.zh: 和約薩拔一起殺了約阿施王，因為王殺害了耶何耶大的兒子撒迦利亞

jozacar: Executed by Amaziah when the kingdom is firm in his hand

jozacar.zh: 亞瑪謝掌穩王權後將他處死

amaziah-2: Defeats Edom in the Valley of Salt, then worships Edom's gods

amaziah-2.zh: 在鹽谷擊敗以東人，後來卻崇拜以東的神

amaziah-2: Challenges Jehoash of Israel; routed, captured, and Jerusalem's wall is broken

amaziah-2.zh: 向以色列王約阿施挑戰；戰敗被擒，耶路撒冷的城牆被拆毀

jehoash-2: Defeats Amaziah of Judah and breaks down part of Jerusalem's wall

jehoash-2.zh: 擊敗猶大王亞瑪謝，拆毀耶路撒冷的一段城牆

jehoash-2: Weeps over the dying Elisha, who promises him victories over Syria

jehoash-2.zh: 為垂死的以利沙哭泣；以利沙應許他會戰勝敘利亞

jehoash-2: Defeats Syria three times and wins back Israel's cities

jehoash-2.zh: 三次擊敗敘利亞，收回以色列的城鎮

ben-hadad-c: Loses the Israelite cities his father took when Jehoash defeats him three times

ben-hadad-c.zh: 約阿施三次打敗他，他失去了父親奪得的以色列城鎮

jeroboam-2: Becomes king of Israel and rules 41 years
Restores Israel's boundaries, as Jonah foretold

jeroboam-2.zh: 恢復以色列的疆界，正如約拿所預言的

amaziah-3: Accuses Amos of sedition and tells him to go back to Judah; Amos foretells his ruin

amaziah-3.zh: 指控阿摩司謀反，叫他回猶大去；阿摩司預言他會遭禍

uzziah-3: Presumptuously burns incense in the temple and is struck with leprosy

uzziah-3.zh: 擅自在聖殿裡燒香，結果染上痲瘋

jotham-3: Handles royal duties while his father Uzziah has leprosy

jotham-3.zh: 父親烏西雅患痲瘋期間，代他處理王室事務

jotham-3: Builds extensively and subdues the Ammonites

jotham-3.zh: 大興土木，並制服了亞捫人

zechariah-14: Reigns six months, the last of Jehu's dynasty; assassinated by Shallum

zechariah-14.zh: 作王六個月，是耶戶王朝的最後一個王；被沙龍殺害

shallum-5: Kills Zechariah and reigns one month; killed by Menahem

shallum-5.zh: 殺了撒迦利亞，作王一個月；被米拿現殺死

menahem: Kills Shallum and becomes king of Israel

menahem.zh: 殺了沙龍，成為以色列王

menahem: Pays Assyria's King Pul 1,000 talents of silver

menahem.zh: 向亞述王普勒進貢1000他連得銀子

pul-1: Invades Israel and takes tribute from King Menahem

pul-1.zh: 入侵以色列，向米拿現王索取貢物

tiglath-pileser-iii: As Pul, invades Israel and takes tribute from King Menahem

tiglath-pileser-iii.zh: 以普勒之名入侵以色列，向米拿現王索取貢物

tiglath-pileser-iii: Takes towns of Israel and deports their people to Assyria

tiglath-pileser-iii.zh: 攻佔以色列的城鎮，把居民擄到亞述

tiglath-pileser-iii: Answers Ahaz's call, captures Damascus and kills Rezin

tiglath-pileser-iii.zh: 回應亞哈斯的求助，攻佔大馬士革，殺了利迅

pekahiah: Succeeds his father Menahem as king
Killed in the palace by his adjutant Pekah

pekahiah.zh: 在王宮裡被副官比加殺害

argob-1: Possibly killed with King Pekahiah when Pekah seizes the throne

argob-1.zh: 比加篡位時，可能與比加轄王一同被殺

arieh: Possibly killed with King Pekahiah when Pekah seizes the throne

arieh.zh: 比加篡位時，可能與比加轄王一同被殺

pekah: Kills Pekahiah and becomes king of Israel

pekah.zh: 殺了比加轄，成為以色列王

pekah: With Rezin of Syria, makes war on Judah under Ahaz

pekah.zh: 與敘利亞王利迅聯手攻打亞哈斯統治的猶大

rezin-1: With Pekah, besieges Jerusalem; takes Elath

rezin-1.zh: 與比加一起圍攻耶路撒冷；奪取以拉他

rezin-1: Killed when Tiglath-pileser III captures Damascus

rezin-1.zh: 提革拉比列色攻佔大馬士革時被殺

ahaz-1: Becomes king of Judah and practices gross idolatry

ahaz-1.zh: 成為猶大王，大行拜偶像的惡事

ahaz-1: Under attack from Syria and Israel, refuses Isaiah's offer of a sign

ahaz-1.zh: 受敘利亞和以色列攻擊時，拒絕以賽亞提出的徵兆

ahaz-1: Pays Tiglath-pileser III; copies a pagan altar he sees at Damascus

ahaz-1.zh: 向提革拉比列色進貢；仿造在大馬士革看見的異教祭壇

urijah-1: Serves as a witness when Isaiah writes on a large tablet

urijah-1.zh: 以賽亞在大板上寫字時作見證人

urijah-1: Builds a copy of the Damascus altar at King Ahaz's order

urijah-1.zh: 奉亞哈斯王之命，仿造大馬士革的祭壇

zechariah-15: Serves as a witness when Isaiah writes on a large tablet

zechariah-15.zh: 以賽亞在大板上寫字時作見證人

shear-jashub: Goes with his father Isaiah to meet King Ahaz

shear-jashub.zh: 和父親以賽亞一起去見亞哈斯王

isaiah-s-wife: Bears Maher-shalal-hash-baz, whose name foretells Assyria's plunder

isaiah-s-wife.zh: 生了瑪黑珥沙拉勒哈施罷斯，這個名字預示亞述會掠奪敘利亞和以色列

zichri-10: In Pekah's invasion of Judah, kills a royal prince and two of Ahaz's high officials

zichri-10.zh: 在比加入侵猶大時，殺了一個王子和亞哈斯的兩個高官

oded-2: Persuades Israel's army to free 200,000 captives taken from Judah

oded-2.zh: 說服以色列軍隊釋放從猶大擄來的二十萬人

jehizkiah: Opposes enslaving the captives from Judah and helps care for them

jehizkiah.zh: 反對奴役從猶大擄來的人，並幫助照顧他們

hoshea-4: Kills Pekah and takes the throne of Israel

hoshea-4.zh: 殺了比加，奪取以色列的王位

hoshea-4: Conspires with Egypt against Assyria and is imprisoned

hoshea-4.zh: 與埃及合謀反抗亞述，被關進監牢

so: King Hoshea of Israel sends to him for help against Assyria

so.zh: 以色列王何細亞派人向他求助，對抗亞述

shalmaneser-v-2: Makes Hoshea a vassal, then besieges Samaria for three years

shalmaneser-v-2.zh: 使何細亞成為附庸，後來圍攻撒馬利亞三年

shalmaneser-v-2: Samaria falls; Israel is taken into exile

shalmaneser-v-2.zh: 撒馬利亞陷落；以色列人被擄

conaniah-1: Put in charge of the contributions brought to the temple

conaniah-1.zh: 負責管理百姓帶到聖殿的捐獻

eliakim-1: Replaces Shebna as steward over the king's house
Speaks with Sennacherib's Rabshakeh; sent to Isaiah

eliakim-1.zh: 與西拿基立的拉伯沙基交涉；被派去見以賽亞

shebna-b: Removed as steward of Hezekiah's house for his pride

shebna-b.zh: 因驕傲被革除管理希西家王宮的職位

shebna-b: As royal secretary, faces Sennacherib's Rabshakeh

shebna-b.zh: 以王室書記的身分與西拿基立的拉伯沙基交涉

merodach-baladan: Sends letters and a gift to Hezekiah after his recovery

merodach-baladan.zh: 希西家病癒後，派人送信和禮物給他

esar-haddon: Succeeds his murdered father Sennacherib as king of Assyria

esar-haddon.zh: 在父親西拿基立被殺後繼任亞述王

asenappar: Moves people from Susa and Elam to the cities of Samaria

asenappar.zh: 把書珊和以攔的人遷到撒馬利亞的城鎮

amon-2: Becomes king of Judah at 22 and serves idols
Murdered by his servants; the people make his son Josiah king

amon-2.zh: 被僕人殺害；百姓立他的兒子約西亞作王

zephaniah-2: Writes the book of Zephaniah early in Josiah's reign

zephaniah-2.zh: 在約西亞統治初期寫成西番雅書

hilkiah-4: Finds the book of the Law in the temple
ahikam: Protects Jeremiah from being put to death

ahikam.zh: 保護耶利米，使他不被處死

huldah: Foretells calamity on Judah but a peaceful death for humble Josiah

huldah.zh: 預言災禍會臨到猶大，但謙卑的約西亞會平平安安地死去

nahum-1: Writes the book of Nahum, foretelling Nineveh's fall

nahum-1.zh: 寫成那鴻書，預言尼尼微會滅亡

jehoiakim: Made king by Pharaoh Necho in place of his brother

jehoiakim.zh: 法老尼哥立他作王，取代他的弟弟

jehoiakim: Cuts up Jeremiah's scroll and burns it piece by piece

jehoiakim.zh: 把耶利米的書卷一段一段割下，扔進火裡燒掉

jehoiakim: Becomes Nebuchadnezzar's vassal for three years, then rebels

jehoiakim.zh: 作尼布甲尼撒的附庸三年，後來背叛

urijah-2: Foretells doom on Judah; flees to Egypt but is brought back and executed by Jehoiakim

urijah-2.zh: 預言猶大會遭毀滅；逃到埃及，卻被帶回來，被約雅敬處死

elnathan-1: Sent by Jehoiakim to Egypt to bring back the prophet Urijah

elnathan-1.zh: 奉約雅敬之命到埃及把先知烏利雅帶回來

elnathan-1: Begs Jehoiakim not to burn Jeremiah's scroll

elnathan-1.zh: 懇求約雅敬不要燒毀耶利米的書卷

baruch-1: Writes down Jeremiah's prophecies as Jeremiah dictates

baruch-1.zh: 把耶利米口述的預言寫下來

baruch-1: Reads the scroll at the temple; after the king burns it, writes it again

baruch-1.zh: 在聖殿裡朗讀書卷；王把書卷燒掉後，他重新寫了一卷
和耶利米一起被帶到埃及

gemariah-1: Baruch reads Jeremiah's scroll from his room at the temple; he begs the king not to burn it

gemariah-1.zh: 巴錄在他位於聖殿的房間裡朗讀耶利米的書卷；他懇求王不要燒毀書卷

micaiah-5: Hears Baruch read the scroll and reports it to the princes

micaiah-5.zh: 聽見巴錄朗讀書卷，就去告訴眾首領

jehudi: Fetches Baruch and the scroll, then reads it to Jehoiakim, who burns it

jehudi.zh: 去把巴錄和書卷帶來，然後讀給約雅敬聽，王把書卷燒了

delaiah-2: Hears Jeremiah's scroll and begs the king not to burn it

delaiah-2.zh: 聽見耶利米的書卷，懇求王不要燒毀

pashhur-3: Strikes Jeremiah and puts him in the stocks; God renames him 'Fright all around'

pashhur-3.zh: 打了耶利米，把他上了木枷；上帝給他改名為「四面驚嚇」

jaazaniah-1: Leads the Rechabites, who refuse the wine Jeremiah offers them in the temple

jaazaniah-1.zh: 帶領利甲族人；他們在聖殿裡拒絕喝耶利米給他們的酒

nehushta: Taken to Babylon with her son Jehoiachin

nehushta.zh: 和兒子約雅斤一起被擄到巴比倫

shemaiah-13: Writes from Babylon urging that Jeremiah be put in the stocks; God decrees his line will not return

shemaiah-13.zh: 從巴比倫寫信，要求把耶利米上枷；上帝宣告他的後代不會歸回

elasah: Sent by Zedekiah to Babylon; carries Jeremiah's letter to the exiles

elasah.zh: 奉西底家之命到巴比倫去；把耶利米的信帶給被擄的人

gemariah-2: Sent by Zedekiah to Babylon; carries Jeremiah's letter to the exiles

gemariah-2.zh: 奉西底家之命到巴比倫去；把耶利米的信帶給被擄的人

hananiah-5: Predicts that Babylon's yoke will break within two years; breaks Jeremiah's wooden yoke

hananiah-5.zh: 預言巴比倫的軛會在兩年內折斷；折斷耶利米的木軛

hananiah-5: Dies that same year, as Jeremiah foretold

hananiah-5.zh: 同年死去，正如耶利米所預言的

seraiah-5: Goes with Zedekiah to Babylon; reads Jeremiah's scroll on Babylon's fall and sinks it in the Euphrates

seraiah-5.zh: 陪西底家去巴比倫；朗讀耶利米關於巴比倫毀滅的書卷，然後把書卷沉到幼發拉底河裡

jaazaniah-2: Seen in Ezekiel's vision among 70 elders burning incense to idols in the temple

jaazaniah-2.zh: 在以西結的異象中，他和70個長老在聖殿裡向偶像燒香

ezekiel-s-wife: Dies the year the siege of Jerusalem begins; Ezekiel is told not to mourn, as a sign

ezekiel-s-wife.zh: 在耶路撒冷被圍困的那一年死去；上帝吩咐以西結不要哀悼，作為一個預兆

pashhur-2: Sent by Zedekiah to ask Jeremiah about Nebuchadnezzar's attack

pashhur-2.zh: 奉西底家之命去向耶利米求問尼布甲尼撒來攻打的事

pashhur-2: Urges that Jeremiah be put to death

zephaniah-3.zh: 奉西底家之命去見耶利米

zephaniah-3: Executed at Riblah after Jerusalem falls

zephaniah-3.zh: 耶路撒冷陷落後在利比拉被處死

gedaliah-3: Accuses Jeremiah of weakening the soldiers; helps throw him into a miry cistern

gedaliah-3.zh: 指控耶利米使士兵喪膽；幫忙把他扔進泥濘的蓄水池

jucal: Demands Jeremiah's death for discouraging the soldiers

jucal.zh: 指耶利米使士兵喪膽，要求把他處死

irijah: Seizes Jeremiah at the Gate of Benjamin, falsely accusing him of deserting

irijah.zh: 在便雅憫門逮捕耶利米，誣告他投敵

hanamel: Sells Jeremiah a field in Anathoth during Babylon's siege

hanamel.zh: 在巴比倫圍城期間把亞拿突的一塊田賣給耶利米

seraiah-6: Chief priest executed at Riblah at Nebuchadnezzar's order

seraiah-6.zh: 祭司長，奉尼布甲尼撒之命在利比拉被處死

jehozadak: Taken captive to Babylon after his father Seraiah is executed

jehozadak.zh: 父親西萊雅被處死後，他被擄到巴比倫

jaazaniah-4: Comes to Governor Gedaliah with other army chiefs

jaazaniah-4.zh: 和其他軍官一起投靠基大利總督

ishmael-5: Murders Governor Gedaliah and takes the people at Mizpah captive

ishmael-5.zh: 殺害基大利總督，擄走在米斯巴的人

ishmael-5: Escapes to the Ammonites when Johanan's men catch up

ishmael-5.zh: 約哈南的人追上時，他逃到亞捫人那裡

baalis: Said to have sent Ishmael to kill Governor Gedaliah

baalis.zh: 據說派以實瑪利去刺殺基大利總督

hophra: Jeremiah foretells his fall as a sign to the Jews in Egypt

hophra.zh: 耶利米預言他會倒台，作為給在埃及的猶太人的徵兆

arioch-2: Ordered to kill Babylon's wise men; brings Daniel to the king to explain the dream

arioch-2.zh: 奉命殺巴比倫的智者；帶但以理去見王，解釋王的夢

evil-merodach: Becomes king and releases Jehoiachin from prison

evil-merodach.zh: 成為巴比倫王，把約雅斤從監牢裡釋放出來

jeshua-4: Returns with Zerubbabel as high priest; rebuilds the altar

jeshua-4.zh: 以大祭司的身分與所羅巴伯一同歸回；重建祭壇

jeshua-4: Leads in laying the foundation of the temple
Encouraged by Haggai and Zechariah to resume the temple work

jeshua-4.zh: 受哈該和撒迦利亞鼓勵，重新展開聖殿的工程

sheshbazzar: Appointed by Cyrus; brings the temple vessels back to Jerusalem

sheshbazzar.zh: 被居魯士任命；把聖殿的器皿帶回耶路撒冷

sheshbazzar: Lays the foundation of the second temple
artaxerxes-1: Heeds false charges from Samaria and orders the temple rebuilding stopped

artaxerxes-1.zh: 聽信撒馬利亞人的誣告，下令停止重建聖殿

shimshai: Forcibly stops the Jews' building work

shimshai.zh: 用武力強迫猶太人停工

rehum-3: Forcibly stops the Jews' building work

rehum-3.zh: 用武力強迫猶太人停工

sharezer-2: Sent from Bethel to ask whether the fasts should continue

sharezer-2.zh: 從伯特利被派去詢問是否應該繼續禁食

ahasuerus-3: Deposes Queen Vashti for refusing to come to his banquet

ahasuerus-3.zh: 因瓦實提王后拒絕到宴會中來，把她廢了

ahasuerus-3: Lets the Jews defend themselves against Haman's plot

ahasuerus-3.zh: 准許猶太人自衛，對抗哈曼的陰謀

vashti: Refuses the king's summons to show her beauty at his banquet; deposed

vashti.zh: 拒絕王的召喚，不肯到宴會中展示美貌；被廢黜

harbona: Mentions the stake Haman made for Mordecai; the king has Haman hanged on it

harbona.zh: 提到哈曼為末底改預備的木柱；王就下令把哈曼掛在上面

hegai: Gives Esther her beauty treatments and favors her

hegai.zh: 為以斯帖安排美容護理，對她特別照顧

haman: Raised to prime minister; Mordecai refuses to bow to him

haman.zh: 被提拔為宰相；末底改拒絕向他下拜

haman: Plots to destroy all the Jews in the empire

haman.zh: 圖謀消滅帝國裡所有的猶太人

haman: Exposed by Esther; hanged on the stake he made for Mordecai

haman.zh: 被以斯帖揭發；被掛在他為末底改預備的木柱上

zeresh: Urges Haman to make a tall stake for Mordecai, then warns he will fall before him

zeresh.zh: 勸哈曼為末底改立一根高木柱，後來又警告他會在末底改面前失敗

hathach: Carries messages between Esther and Mordecai

hathach.zh: 在以斯帖和末底改之間傳話

artaxerxes-2: Authorizes Ezra to take gifts and exiles to Jerusalem

artaxerxes-2.zh: 授權以斯拉帶著禮物和被擄的人回耶路撒冷

artaxerxes-2: Sends Nehemiah to rebuild Jerusalem's walls

artaxerxes-2.zh: 派尼希米回去重建耶路撒冷的城牆

hanani-3b: Brings Nehemiah word of Jerusalem's broken-down wall

hanani-3b.zh: 告訴尼希米耶路撒冷城牆被拆毀的消息

meshullam-16: Gives his daughter in marriage to Tobiah's son Jehohanan

meshullam-16.zh: 把女兒嫁給多比亞的兒子耶何哈南

malchijah-9: Repairs the Gate of the Ash-heaps
shallun: Repairs the Fountain Gate and the wall of the Pool of the Canal

shallun.zh: 修築泉門和水道池的城牆

eliashib-6: With his fellow priests, rebuilds the Sheep Gate

eliashib-6.zh: 和其他祭司一起重建羊門

eliashib-6: Gives his relative Tobiah a dining hall in the temple

eliashib-6.zh: 在聖殿裡把一個膳堂給了他的親屬多比亞

sanballat: Mocks the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall and plots against Nehemiah

sanballat.zh: 嘲笑重建耶路撒冷城牆的工作，並設計陷害尼希米

tobiah-2: Mocks and schemes against Nehemiah's rebuilding of the wall

tobiah-2.zh: 嘲笑並陰謀破壞尼希米重建城牆的工作

tobiah-2: Thrown out of a temple dining hall by Nehemiah

tobiah-2.zh: 被尼希米趕出聖殿的膳堂

shemaiah-21: Paid by Tobiah and Sanballat to frighten Nehemiah into hiding in the temple

shemaiah-21.zh: 收了多比亞和桑巴拉的錢，想嚇唬尼希米躲進聖殿

noadiah-2: Tries to frighten Nehemiah into stopping the work on the wall

noadiah-2.zh: 想恐嚇尼希米，使他停止建造城牆

abijah-6d: Joins in sealing the covenant resolution
joiada-2: Nehemiah drives away his son, who has married Sanballat's daughter

joiada-2.zh: 他的兒子娶了桑巴拉的女兒，被尼希米趕走

hanan-7d: Appointed by Nehemiah to hand out the Levites' shares

hanan-7d.zh: 被尼希米委派分配利未人的份

simeon-3: Holds the infant Jesus in the temple; foretells Mary's grief

simeon-3.zh: 在聖殿裡抱著嬰孩耶穌；預言馬利亞會非常傷心

anna: Sees the infant Jesus at the temple and speaks about him to those awaiting deliverance

anna.zh: 在聖殿裡看見嬰孩耶穌，向所有等待救贖的人談論他

quirinius: Governor of Syria during the registration that brings Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem

quirinius.zh: 在登記戶口期間擔任敘利亞總督；這次登記使約瑟和馬利亞來到伯利恆

archelaus: Rules Judea after Herod; fearing him, Joseph settles in Nazareth

archelaus.zh: 在希律之後統治猶地亞；約瑟因怕他而定居在拿撒勒

judas-the-galilean-2: Leads a revolt at the time of the registration; he perishes and his followers scatter

judas-the-galilean-2.zh: 在登記戶口期間發動叛亂；他死了，跟隨他的人都四散了

herod-antipas-2: Rules Galilee when John the Baptizer begins preaching

herod-antipas-2.zh: 施浸者約翰開始傳道時，他統治加利利

herod-antipas-2: Imprisons John the Baptizer for rebuking his marriage to Herodias

herod-antipas-2.zh: 因施浸者約翰譴責他娶希羅底，把約翰關進監牢

herod-antipas-2: Has John the Baptizer beheaded at his birthday feast

herod-antipas-2.zh: 在生日宴會上下令斬了施浸者約翰的頭

herod-antipas-2: Mocks Jesus at his trial and sends him back to Pilate

herod-antipas-2.zh: 在耶穌受審時嘲弄他，又把他送回彼拉多那裡

herod-antipas-2: Banished to Gaul after Agrippa I accuses him before Caligula

herod-antipas-2.zh: 希律向卡利古拉控告他，他被放逐到高盧

herodias: Resents John the Baptizer's rebuke of her marriage to Antipas

herodias.zh: 施浸者約翰譴責她嫁給安提帕，她因此懷恨在心

herodias: Through her daughter, gets John the Baptizer's head

herodias.zh: 藉著女兒得到施浸者約翰的頭

salome-2: Dances before Herod Antipas and, prompted by her mother, asks for John the Baptizer's head

salome-2.zh: 在希律·安提帕面前跳舞，受母親唆使，要求得到施浸者約翰的頭

nathanael: Brought to Jesus by Philip; praised as 'an Israelite in whom there is no deceit'

nathanael.zh: 腓力帶他去見耶穌；耶穌稱讚他是「心裡沒有詭詐的以色列人」

nathanael: Sees the resurrected Jesus at the Sea of Galilee

nathanael.zh: 在加利利海邊看見復活的耶穌

philip-apostle: Follows Jesus and brings Nathanael to him

philip-apostle.zh: 跟從耶穌，並帶拿但業去見他

philip-apostle: From Bethsaida, the town of Andrew and Peter

philip-apostle.zh: 來自伯賽大，就是安得烈和彼得的家鄉

philip-apostle: Waits and prays with the other apostles in the upper room in Jerusalem

philip-apostle.zh: 和其他使徒一起在耶路撒冷的樓上房間等候、禱告

philip-apostle: Jesus asks him where to buy bread for the crowd of 5,000

philip-apostle.zh: 耶穌問他到哪裡買餅給五千人吃

philip-apostle: With Andrew, tells Jesus that some Greeks want to see him

philip-apostle.zh: 和安得烈一起告訴耶穌，有些希臘人想見他

joanna: With other women, ministers to Jesus and the apostles from her belongings

joanna.zh: 和其他婦女一起用自己的財物供應耶穌和使徒

joanna: Finds Jesus' tomb empty and tells the apostles

joanna.zh: 發現耶穌的墓是空的，就告訴使徒

jairus: Begs Jesus to heal his dying daughter; Jesus raises her from the dead

jairus.zh: 懇求耶穌醫治他垂死的女兒；耶穌使她復活

jairus-daughter: Raised from the dead by Jesus: 'Talitha cumi'

jairus-daughter.zh: 被耶穌復活：「塔利塔，古米」

legion: Freed by Jesus from many demons, which go into a herd of swine

legion.zh: 耶穌把許多邪靈從他身上趕出去，邪靈進入了一群豬

simon-3c: A sinful woman anoints Jesus' feet at his meal

simon-3c.zh: 在他的宴席上，一個有罪的女人用油抹耶穌的腳

caiaphas: Counsels that Jesus must die for the nation

caiaphas.zh: 主張耶穌應當為國家而死

caiaphas: Tries Jesus before the Sanhedrin and condemns him

caiaphas.zh: 在猶太公議會審問耶穌，判他有罪

annas: Jesus is brought to him first after his arrest

annas.zh: 耶穌被捕後先被帶到他那裡

annas: Opposes the apostles Peter and John
john-5: Joins in questioning and threatening Peter and John

john-5.zh: 參與審問並恐嚇彼得和約翰

malchus: Peter cuts off his ear in Gethsemane; Jesus heals it

malchus.zh: 在客西馬尼園，彼得砍掉了他的耳朵；耶穌把耳朵治好了

barabbas: Released by Pilate instead of Jesus at the crowd's demand

barabbas.zh: 群眾要求釋放他，彼拉多就釋放他而不釋放耶穌

pilate-s-wife: Sends Pilate a warning about Jesus because of a dream

pilate-s-wife.zh: 因為做了一個夢，派人警告彼拉多不要害耶穌

evildoer-beside-jesus: Rebukes the other criminal; Jesus promises he will be in Paradise

evildoer-beside-jesus.zh: 責備另一個罪犯；耶穌應許他會在樂園裡

poor-widow-at-the-temple: Puts two small coins into the treasury, all she had to live on

poor-widow-at-the-temple.zh: 把兩個小錢投進聖殿的捐獻箱，那是她全部的生活費

simon-3d: Mary anoints Jesus with costly oil at his house

simon-3d.zh: 馬利亞在他家裡用珍貴的香油膏耶穌

mary-4: Watches Jesus' execution from a distance

mary-4.zh: 在遠處看著耶穌被處死

mary-4: Finds the tomb empty and meets the resurrected Jesus

mary-4.zh: 發現墓是空的，遇見了復活的耶穌

matthias: Chosen by lot to replace Judas Iscariot as an apostle

matthias.zh: 抽籤選出，取代加略人猶大成為使徒

ananias-1: Lies about the price of a field he gave; exposed by Peter, he falls dead

ananias-1.zh: 謊報賣田的價錢；被彼得揭穿後倒地死了

sapphira: Joins her husband's lie about the field's price; exposed by Peter, she falls dead

sapphira.zh: 和丈夫一起謊報賣田的價錢；被彼得揭穿後倒地死了

ananias-2: Sent by Jesus in a vision to restore Saul's sight

ananias-2.zh: 耶穌在異象中派他去使保羅恢復視力

simon-3f: Baptized after Philip's preaching; tries to buy the gift of holy spirit

simon-3f.zh: 聽了腓力傳道後受浸；想用錢買聖靈的恩賜

ethiopian-eunuch: Taught by Philip about Jesus while reading Isaiah; baptized on the road to Gaza

ethiopian-eunuch.zh: 閱讀以賽亞書時，腓力向他講解有關耶穌的事；他在往迦薩的路上受浸

aretas: His governor guards Damascus to seize Paul, who escapes in a basket

aretas.zh: 他的總督守住大馬士革要捉拿保羅，保羅坐在筐子裡逃走

aeneas: Paralyzed for eight years, he is healed by Peter at Lydda

aeneas.zh: 癱瘓了八年，在呂大被彼得治好

dorcas: Raised from the dead by Peter
simon-9: Hosts the apostle Peter for many days in his seaside home

simon-9.zh: 在海邊的家裡接待使徒彼得多日

herod-agrippa-i-3: Made king by Caligula over the lands his uncle Philip had ruled

herod-agrippa-i-3.zh: 卡利古拉立他為王，統治他叔叔腓力從前的領地

herod-agrippa-i-3: Claudius adds Judea and Samaria to his kingdom

herod-agrippa-i-3.zh: 克勞狄把猶地亞和撒馬利亞也加給他

herod-agrippa-i-3: Has the apostle James put to death by the sword
